set.body:
Outcome

Prove that the refactor leaves no architectural residue.

Acceptance

- The canonical legacy-symbol search is empty across production, tests, examples, build files, and current docs.
- No public adapter, compatibility module, duplicate result shell, alternate source ontology, or temporary unsafe constructor remains.
- Git diff review confirms unrelated work is preserved.
- Focused and aggregate JVM/Scala.js compilation and tests pass after deletion.
set.title: P6.7: run the atomic cutover and zero-cruft court
